metadata.description: Live-captured GET /api/mdm/updates/deployments/{uuid} against a real deployment created in a disposable sdktestrun* org group under parent 138883 (deleted after capture). The smart_group_uuids array is not touched by the standard key-based anonymizer (plural-keyed uuid arrays aren't matched by its single-value string heuristic), so its one entry was manually replaced with a placeholder UUID in place of the real captured smart group uuid. deployment_start_time reads "2024-01-15T00:00:00Z" because the anonymizer's timestamp-normalization rule rewrites any field whose key contains "date"/"time" to this exact literal whenever the captured value looks like a timestamp -- a disclosed normalization artifact, not a fabrication; multiple other genuine fixtures in this corpus carry the identical literal for the same field-key-matching reason.
